title: Living On Dividends -The 3 Bucket Retirement System : How to Build a Retirement Portfolio
description: Living on Dividends: The 3-Bucket Retirement System Retirement changes the job of your money. While you were working, your portfolio had one primary goal: growth. But once the paycheck stops, your investments must begin doing several jobs at the same time—providing income for today, protecting you during difficult markets, and continuing to grow for the years ahead. Living on Dividends: The 3-Bucket Retirement System introduces a simple, practical framework for organizing retirement savings around those three jobs. Inside this easy-to-follow guide, you will learn how to: Calculate your true retirement income gap Build a Foundation Bucket for liquidity and short-term security Create an Income Bucket designed to help produce a reliable retirement paycheck Maintain a Growth Bucket to help fight inflation and support a retirement that could last 20, 25, or even 30 years Understand why total return matters more than simply chasing the highest yield Evaluate dividend and income ETFs by looking at NAV, distributions, strategy, expenses, and tax considerations Create rules for replenishing and rebalancing each bucket Prepare for a 20% or 30% market decline before it happens Use spending guardrails to help protect your portfolio during difficult markets Turn your retirement savings into a coordinated system instead of one large pile of investments The book also walks through practical retirement examples, including how a retiree with a $600,000 portfolio could calculate the amount needed from investments and organize the portfolio around that income requirement. You'll also receive simple worksheets designed to help you calculate your own income gap, determine how much you may want in each bucket, and review your retirement plan each year. title: The Buckets of Money Retirement Solution: The Ultimate Guide to Income for Life
description: Investors, shell-shocked by the "Great Recession" of 2008-2009, are looking for answers, for something fresher than the old 'buy-and-hold' mantra. Lucia, a Certified Financial Planner who's helped thousands of people invest more than $2 billion, explains how to spend down 'safe' buckets (containing, for example, Treasuries, CDs, bonds), while leaving a riskier bucket (real estate, stocks and alternative investments) to grow long-term. This strategy shields investors from the short-term ups and downs of the market. And it gives them the courage and discipline to stay invested no matter what the future holds. Written in a breezy, accessible style and loaded with tons of examples and clear, specific calculations, the book explains how to set your financial goals, divvy up your money accordingly, and then invest intelligently. With this book as your guide, readers will learn how to achieve both income and growth while at the same time reducing risk. Almost every kind of investment—stocks, bonds, commodities, real estate—plunged in the past year or two, turning off millions of investors who'd been planning for and counting on a reasonably comfortable retirement.
